thread:
alex_k: Kickoff for ACME on-prem bring-up. Using this thread to track bootstrap, network validation, and capacity/cost checks. Target: rack-01 with 8x A100-40G, air-gapped. ETA 3 days. Root tasks: mirror images, seed node bootstrap, BGP peering, MTU validation, and acceptance tests. I’ll start the seed sync now.

marie_ops: Copy. I’m doing SKU inventory and rack naming now. Ping me the exact firewall whitelist and the seed image sha256 once available.

sam_edge: Quick MTU note — customer core switch only supports 1500. If we can’t get their team to enable jumbo frames, overlay perf will drop. We need a fallback plan (tune TCP/TLS window + smaller batch sizes).

chris_net: FYI BGP plan: customer ASN 65034, our ASN 65010. We’ll announce a /24 from their edge. Need to confirm they accept external ML traffic on port 443 and BGP TTL. Also ask if they require MD5 on neighborship.

deploy-bot: PROVISION_JOB 9832 started: steps queued -> seed-image-sync -> registry-mirror -> kube-bootstrap.

marie_ops: Checklist I’m tracking: 1) Mirror images to local registry (rwd-seed.local) 2) Seed node init token 3) NVidia driver + toolkit install 4) Kernel params (iommu, hugepages) 5) Node labels/taints for GPU pool.

alex_k: Airgap specifics: we mirror these artifacts: rwd-runtime:sha256:abcdef123..., runtime-tools:sha256:bcdef234..., nvidia-driver:sha256:cdef345... Keep checksums in the handoff doc. Mirror via `skopeo copy` to the hosted registry then `ctr images import` on hosts.

sam_edge: For hosts we’ll use MTU 1500 for overlays to match core. To mitigate perf loss, recommend: 1) enable kernel tcp_small_queue tweaks, 2) set pod annotations for smaller send windows, 3) enable hardware offload where possible. I’ll draft exact sysctl values.

chris_net: Also confirm firewall: allow outbound 443 to our update mirror rwd-updates.redwood.internal:5000 and 5222 for licensing, plus BGP TCP 179. If customer insists on proxy, we need credentials for the jump host.

marie_ops: Cost consideration: ACME asked about cheaper SKUs. Option A = keep 8x A100 (higher perf), Option B = 4x A40 per rack (more nodes). Rough cost delta ~ -22% if we choose A40s. Tradeoff: throughput and latency. Ops needs to update capacity spreadsheet before signoff.

deploy-bot: PROVISION_JOB 9832: registry-mirror completed (4 images mirrored). Next step: apply seed manifests -> kube-bootstrap.

tina_qa: I’ll run acceptance once bootstrap completes. Smoke checklist (run locally): `./tools/cluster-acceptance.sh --smoke --gpu` — verifies node labels, `nvidia-smi`, device-plugin health, basic sample generation load. I’ll log results to /tmp/acme-acceptance-<ts>.

marie_ops: Important: confirm kubelet cgroup driver is systemd to match CRI. If mismatch, kube-proxy flakiness observed in past on 1.25 clusters.

deploy-bot: BOOTSTRAP_JOB 9832-2 started: kube-bootstrap -> daemonset nvidia-driver -> device-plugin.

tina_qa: Smoke results: nodes Ready, nvidia-driver 535.* installed, device-plugin healthy. Two warnings: 1) kubelet cgroup driver shows `cgroupfs` on node-03, 2) kernel rcu_stall warnings intermittently on node-03 during driver install.

chris_net: RCU stall usually old kernel. Customer kernel is 5.10.x? We need 5.15+ or backport patches. I’ll open a ticket with their infra team and propose bump to 5.15.0-80 or latest stable.

alex_k: Decisions/actions: 1) Customer to confirm switch firmware or accept MTU 1500 fallback; 2) Customer to upgrade kernel OR accept RCU risk; 3) Ops to finalize cost SKU decision (A100 first, A40 spare pool preferred); 4) QA to rerun acceptance after node-03 kernel fix. If all green, we’ll schedule handoff call Wed 15:00 PST. :thumbsup: 

sam_edge: I’ll post the sysctl tuning snippet in follow-up and the exact sha256 values for the mirrored tarballs.

marie_ops: Confirming I’ll update the capacity and cost doc and prepare the handoff checklist for the call.

alex_k: Thanks everyone. Tagging @deploy-bot for final status after bootstrap so we can move to handoff.

deploy-bot: PROVISION_JOB 9832: current status -> waiting on customer kernel upgrade and MTU decision.
